info.name: Suunto (aifitnessapi.com)
info.description: Suunto: OAuth 2.0 requests built from the vendor documentation aifitnessapi.com quotes. Generated by scripts/build-collections.mjs; no secrets included. https://aifitnessapi.com/collections

item.name: OAuth 2.0
item.description:
Suunto's authorization-code flow as its documentation describes it, read 2026-11-05. Fill client_id, redirect_uri and scope in an environment of your own and keep client_secret there, never in a shared collection. No refresh request: The token response includes a refresh_token, but the pages read here document no refresh request, so this tool prints none.

The same facts, with each source sentence, at https://aifitnessapi.com/integrate/suunto-api and https://aifitnessapi.com/tools/oauth-playground.

request.description:
https://cloudapi-oauth.suunto.com/oauth/authorize. Authorization URL. Open this URL in a browser (in Postman: copy it from the request bar); the user signs in and Suunto redirects to {{redirect_uri}} with ?code=… Put that value in the auth_code variable.

Source: Suunto API Zone, “How to start”, https://apizone.suunto.com/how-to-start

Scope: No scope list is published on the pages read here and Suunto's authorization URL carries no scope parameter; its sample token response shows the scope workout. Source: Suunto API Zone, “How to start”, https://apizone.suunto.com/how-to-start

PKCE: Not mentioned on Suunto's quick-start or FAQ.

https://cloudapi-oauth.suunto.com/oauth/token. Token URL, with HTTP Basic client credentials.

Source: Suunto API Zone, “How to start”, https://apizone.suunto.com/how-to-start

Client credentials go as HTTP Basic: {{client_id}} as the user name, {{client_secret}} as the password.

Token lifetime: Suunto's sample response shows expires_in 86400 (24 hours). The access token is a JWT whose user claim is the Suunto app user name. Source: Suunto API Zone, “How to start”, https://apizone.suunto.com/how-to-start

Note: The token endpoint uses HTTP Basic: Base64(clientid:clientsecret). Source: Suunto API Zone, “FAQ”, https://apizone.suunto.com/faq

Note: OAuth requests need no subscription key; Cloud API data calls do (Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key). Source: Suunto API Zone, “FAQ”, https://apizone.suunto.com/faq
